Noah (Product Design): Quick follow-up from testing: users get confused whether Export downloads all rows or only selected ones. Also compact rows lose the tiny preview that power users rely on. Thoughts? :thinking:
Ivy (Frontend): We can surface scope in the button label like `Export · selected: 4` and anchor the dropdown so expanding rows don't shift layout. For compact rows, show a 20px inline sparkline SVG to keep scanability. I'll prototype in storybook.
Sonia (Accessibility): Important: sparklines must include a <title> or offscreen text, and chips can't rely on color alone. Add short text fallback (H/M/L) hidden visually but readable by screen readers. Export menu needs aria-labels and focus trap.
Alden (PM): From interviews: default export should be "Selected" when selection exists, otherwise "Visible". Also suggest a small helper line under the export button: "Exports selected rows unless you choose another option." Track analytics: export_scope, export_count, export_format.
Remy (Design Intern): Mocked a compact toolbar with a persistent export affordance and a tiny scope badge. Upload: https://redwood.ai/s/mock-compact-export.png :art:
Ivy (Frontend): CSS quick idea:
```css
.toolbar { position: sticky; top: 0; }
.export-btn { min-width: 160px; }
.row--compact .spark { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
```
Will add aria-expanded/controls for row toggles and move focus into expanded panels.
Sonia (Accessibility): Keyboard flow: Enter/Right Arrow expands a row and focus moves to the first control inside; Escape/Left Arrow collapses and returns focus. Announce exports with an aria-live region ("Export started: 4 vectors"). We'll run NVDA/VoiceOver on the prototype.
Alden (PM): Good. For large exports (>5000) show a modal suggesting background export with a link to the exports page. Default formats: CSV (default) and JSON (advanced).
Ivy (Frontend): Branch `feat/compact-export-badge`. I'll add localStorage persistence for compact/comfortable toggle and a feature flag `vec-export-scope` for rollout. ETA: tomorrow AM.
preview-bot: Storybook preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/builds/2014567890  includes compact toolbar, sparklines, and export scope badge.
Noah (Product Design): Thanks everyone. Checklist before PR: export label with scope badge, anchored dropdown, 20px sparkline with <title>, aria labels + focus trap, default export behavior, large-export modal, persist toggle. Gate behind `vec-compact-export` flag and pilot with a small group. :white_check_mark:
